utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are you starting the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out in about ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks. Just tell me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the drill, some screws, and a few spare batteries.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive's getting a solid bit of support now. Folks around here have been talking it up all morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, seems like word’s really getting around. If the support keeps up like this, they might have a decent turnout.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, could you tell me where and when the repair drive is?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it’s at the community center on Saturday from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. I can send the address too if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive, so come by if you can and bring anyone who wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by for a bit, though I may keep to myself. Thanks for letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, glad you can make it for a bit. Come say hi when you arrive, and you can always hang back if you’d rather keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll help keep everything moving so we can cover the most important fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I’ll start with the urgent fixes and keep the list tight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll keep the list focused and help track the rest so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me what needs fixing on the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It’s the fence and a loose step by the porch. I can point out the rest when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I’ll wait for you to point out the rest when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after school drop-off, but I need to keep it quick between runs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot, Faye. I’ll keep the repair drive quick and line up a job you can jump into between drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I can do a quick job between drop-offs. Just tell me where to start and I’ll swing by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m only getting it second-hand. Is there anything I should know before I show up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, come by around noon if you can. We’ll have a quick sign-in, a list of jobs, and plenty of people around to help if you’re new to it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll plan for noon and bring myself up to speed when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, just point me to what needs fixing and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure, but can you confirm which repairs you want me to check first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the biggest issues first: roof, leaks, and the front door.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. Tell me what still needs fixing, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing. I think the porch light and the loose step still need fixing, but I might be forgetting one more thing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That should be enough to start. Let’s check the porch light and the loose step first, and then see if anything else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll start checking what parts we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll help track down the parts and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along, but I haven’t gotten the latest yet. I can check when I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem, I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was going to help with that, wasn’t I?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I think you said you would. We can still get you lined up for it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’d still like to help. Point me to where you need me and I’ll try not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might've missed the latest update, so what do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: You can still help with pickups this afternoon. I’ll send the exact list in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — send me the pickup list when you have it, and I’ll be ready this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a few screwdrivers if that helps. Just tell me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d help a lot, Gus. Bring them over to the front steps, and we’ll start with the loose hinge on the garage door.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it — I’ll bring them over now and we can get that hinge fixed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can help with that repair drive. What’s the first thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thank you. First up, can you help me spread the word and see who can bring tools or spare parts?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and ask who can bring tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word and bring a few more hands if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would help a lot. I’m still pinning down the exact spots we need hands at, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, just let me know when the list’s ready and I’ll help round up the right folks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ve got the repair drive on my list and I’m coordinating the next steps now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep an eye on supplies and let you know if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks, Cleo. I’ll circle back once I’ve got the next steps locked in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive's moving along, but I'm a little behind on the details. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's still on track, just a bit slower than we'd hoped. They've started the next round of repairs, and I'll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks. Just keep me posted if the next round changes anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, I appreciate it. I can work around the school pickup window if we keep it to after 3.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: After 3 works for me too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what’s left to do on it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I just need to check the remaining tasks and I’ll tell you exactly what’s left.
